data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD5: Update validate_cycle_end_ruling in arbiter.py to enforce enum membership: cross_reviewer_agreement values ⊂ 4-set, cross_cycle_pattern values ⊂ 7-set, impact_class ∈ 9-set (8 floor + 'none'). Raise ValueError on unknown values. New schema requires these fields present.

## TDD Requirement
Add 4 new tests to tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py:

1. test_validate_cycle_end_ruling_enforces_cross_reviewer_agreement_enum
2. test_validate_cycle_end_ruling_enforces_cross_cycle_pattern_enum
3. test_validate_cycle_end_ruling_enforces_impact_class_enum
4. test_validate_cycle_end_ruling_rejects_missing_required_fields

All FAIL first, then PASS.

## Implementation Notes
Update `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/arbiter.py`:

Add module-level enum constants:
```python
VALID_CROSS_REVIEWER_AGREEMENT: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
    "UNANIMOUS", "MAJORITY", "SPLIT", "SINGLE_REVIEWER",
})
VALID_CROSS_CYCLE_PATTERN: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
    "NEW_INTRODUCED", "RECURRING", "RESUSTAIN_OF",
    "RESOLVED_THEN_REINTRODUCED", "ESCALATED",
    "DEFENDED_PRIOR_CYCLE", "UNKNOWN",
})
VALID_IMPACT_CLASS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
    "bug", "unintended_behavior", "security_vulnerability",
    "data_loss_or_corruption", "secret_exposure",
    "compliance_violation", "api_contract_break", "infrastructure_break",
    "none",
})
```

Extend validate_cycle_end_ruling to require + validate these fields:
- cross_reviewer_agreement: list of strings, each ∈ VALID_CROSS_REVIEWER_AGREEMENT
- cross_cycle_pattern: list of strings, each ∈ VALID_CROSS_CYCLE_PATTERN  
- impact_class: single string ∈ VALID_IMPACT_CLASS

Raise ValueError with descriptive message on unknown enum value. Backward-compat: missing fields raise ValueError (new schema requires them) — but only for cycle-end rulings, not legacy code-reviewer-verifier rulings.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] All 4 new enum-enforcement tests pass
  Verify: python -m pytest \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter.py -k "enforces_cross_reviewer_agreement_enum or enforces_cross_cycle_pattern_enum or enforces_impact_class_enum or rejects_missing_required_fields" 2>&1 | grep -E "4 passed"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
